derivation.hash: lowercase hex SHA-256 of the specified exact UTF-8 bytes
derivation.validation: Manually specified canonical strings compared with JS primitive serialization/UTF16 key sorting for these finite valid vectors; SHA-256 computed with Node standard crypto.
caveats: Invalid examples state required semantics; this script does not implement a strict duplicate-aware or raw UTF-8 JSON parser.
Numbers use binary64 rounding and ECMAScript number serialization; the safe-integer bound is an additional LN profile rule.
The body hash is over the body text itself; R hash is over the JCS representation in which body is a JSON string.
GET null body fields are distinct from POST body text null and POST JSON empty-string text.
This script does not exhaustively validate RFC8785, transport behavior, payment evidence or implementation readiness.

invalid_body_vectors.reason: Duplicate member names after escape decoding; detect before ordinary JSON.parse discards one value.
Unpaired Unicode surrogate in member name.
LN safe-integer profile; not a restriction imposed by RFC8785 itself.
Integer-valued exponent spelling must not bypass the LN safe-integer limit.
Decimal-point spelling must not bypass the LN safe-integer limit.
UTF-8 encoding of a surrogate is invalid; do not decode with replacement characters.
